root_cause.text: In ntfs_fill_super(), the fc->fs_private pointer is set to NULL without first freeing the allocated ntfs_mount_options structure, causing ntfs_fs_free() to skip freeing it and resulting in a memory leak.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description states: "In ntfs_fill_super(), the fc->fs_private pointer is set to NULL without first freeing the memory it points to. This causes the subsequent call to ntfs_fs_free() to skip freeing the ntfs_mount_options structure." The patch diff confirms removal of the line "fc->fs_private = NULL;" (line 1254).

This causes the subsequent call to ntfs_fs_free() to skip freeing the ntfs_mount_options structure." The patch diff confirms removal of the line "fc->fs_private = NULL;" (line 1254).

intent_record.intent_summary: Standardize mount option cleanup by using put_mount_options helper instead of open-coded freeing.
intent_record.what: Replaced three separate cleanup calls (unload_nls, kfree of nls_name, kfree of options struct) with a single call to put_mount_options(sbi->options) in ntfs_put_super.
intent_record.how: Mount option cleanup is now delegated to the VFS helper put_mount_options, which handles unloading NLS, freeing the NLS name, and freeing the options structure, ensuring consistent resource release.

intent_record.intent_summary: Remove premature NULL assignment to fc->fs_private to fix potential use-after-free by preserving ownership of the options structure in the filesystem context.
intent_record.what: Removed the line that sets fc->fs_private to NULL after assigning options to sbi->options in ntfs_fill_super.
intent_record.how: Previously, after storing the options pointer in sbi->options, the filesystem context's private pointer was cleared to NULL. With this change, fc->fs_private retains its previous value (likely the options structure), altering the ownership and lifecycle of the private data, which could prevent premature freeing or use-after-free conditions.

intent_record.intent_summary: Refactor error path in ntfs_fill_super to use standard VFS mount options cleanup function put_mount_options instead of manual resource deallocation.
intent_record.what: Replaced manual cleanup of mount options (unload_nls, kfree nls_name, kfree options) with a call to put_mount_options(sbi->options).
intent_record.how: At runtime, the function put_mount_options handles the proper cleanup and reference counting of the mount options structure, ensuring all associated resources (e.g., NLS) are released correctly and avoiding potential leaks or double frees.

Remove premature NULL assignment to fc->fs_private to fix potential use-after-free by preserving ownership of the options structure in the filesystem context.

relevance_review.reason: The group refactors the error path to use put_mount_options, which ensures the ntfs_mount_options structure is freed properly, directly addressing the memory leak vulnerability.

The group removes the premature NULL assignment to fc->fs_private, which directly addresses the root cause of the memory leak by ensuring the allocated structure is not lost, allowing ntfs_fs_free() to properly free it.
